description: Recent large ($-value) DEX Swap events (Uniswap V3 + Aerodrome) on the Base pools the new-pairs watcher tracks — a whale-following / copy-trading signal. POST `{ min?, dex?, since?, limit?, direction? }`; each swap gives the pool, token, quote (WETH/USDC), USD size, direction (buy/sell of the token), block + approx age, txHash. usdValue is the quote side (WETH×ETH-USD or USDC). Unpaid: free while the caller's IP has free-trial calls left that day (a small daily allowance shared across the trial stalls, no wallet); otherwise returns 402. (PAID x402 service — USDC on Base; the MCP server needs a funded wallet to settle.) Price: $0.005 USD (fixed).

min.description: Only swaps of at least this USD size (default 10000)

since.description: Only swaps at or after this block

name: whale_swaps
